title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I am 58 years old doing business. I had taken a loan from the bank to do business about 40 years back as my father had died. Since then, I am unable to pay the loan and clear the dues. I would like you to give me some dua or prayer where Allah will clear my dues and I would like to live according to the Shariat 2191 views Q. Please give any good wazifah or dua for reciting, as my khala is not getting any good marriage proposal 2056 views Q. Since past 3 years searching for bride. Many proposals are coming but still it is unsuccessful. Please suggest any dua for getting married soon. 2709 views Q. salaam 1408 views Q. Cancer Disease solution by Quran 34770 views Q. Belivig in magic, saya and treating by quranic verses in allowed in islam? 7414 views Q. Please tell me few easy DUA to read because there is so much disturbance in my family since last two years. Hamare ghar mein aapas mein jhagre bahut hone lage hain. Hamari ek choti sister hai jo shadi ke laik hai uski umar 29 sal ki ho gai hai uski shadi nahin ho pa rahi hai hai rishte aate hain aur usko pasand bhi karte hain lekin bad mein inkar ho jata hai, barai karam koi DUA batain. 3539 views Q. جب کبھی میں بزنس شرو ع کرتاہوں اور کامیابی کا وقت قریب ہوتاہے تو ہر چیز غلط ہوجاتی ہے، اور میں کئی مرتبہ ناکام ہوچکا ہوں 1443 views Q. I am having a lot of trouble in my marriage of 12 years - my husband keeps doubting me and bad mouths me to his and my family and friends. I have sworn on the Quraan that I have not done anything wrong but he fails to understand. He abuses me infront of the neighbors and does not talk to me or sleep with me. This has been going on for the past few years. He is very very 'Shaqqi' - I have tried to make him understand and tried to always go to him and make him understand but his 'ana' / ego is such that he will be ok for a few days and then again start asking me for money - for the past few years he has not supported me financially and always asks me what I do with my money. Please help me - I am a working mother of 2 kids in the US. Please write the dua in English since I am not very well versed with Arabic, i am still learning, Insha Allah. 1987 views Q. AOK,janab,from last 10 yrs i have been suffering from panic disorder.i cant travel in any public transport.i am married & have 2 kids.i have been taking medicines regularly,but now they are not working.i fear very mutch when i am alone,i cant sleep alone.all the day my concentration is on myself,i think who i am,i cant look into the mirror.i offer salat 5 times daily,read tasbihat also,i am living avery stressful life,i also had bad dreams at night.pl.tell me if theres any solution for rest of my life.a humble request to you all pl. pray for me & my family very sternly.ALLAH HAFIZ.THANKS 1808 views Q. I have been married since 3 years. Till now my wife dint get pregnant. She says offspring are given by Allah. Please can you give me some wazifah and prophetic medicine for the child. 2630 views Q. Respected sir maulna saab my name is imran . i pray namaz five times a day but from few days i faces very big problems . i am getting very bad thoughts in my minds about islam and for allah i cant express to u because i feel very shame while in namaz also i am trying to control it but i cant i feel very guilty i also do zikir of astkfar but it not help me so pls help me. 1958 views Q. My wife gets vry angry on silly things......her temper gets very high and some of the times she often asks for talaq in anger.....there were my faults also....i gave her talaq only once..Can u please tell me any dua or tasbeeh that might help to calm her in her life and also is there some islamic book on relation and manners of sex in islam? 6528 views Q. Dua for niyat of roza(fast) 18410 views Q. I will be highly thankful if you suggest me a wazifah for the beauty and attraction of face 2511 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 43442 Country: India Title: Wazifah Question: Can you please tell me any wazifah to do after salah? Answer ID: 43442 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 259/259/M=1434) Recite Ayatal Kursi after each fardh salah. Also recite Third Kalimah 100 times, Durood 100 times and Istighfar 100 times in the morning and evening (after Asr and Fajr salah). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
